issues_detected.description: The description states this Beta release 'includes Perturb-seq data for MDA-MB-468 breast cancer cells with and without treatment and for undifferentiated (parental) KOLF2.1J iPSCs', but no MDA-MB-468 Perturb-seq file appears among the ten file_collections entries, and external_resources marks 'Perturb-seq data in KOLF2.1J iPSCs (undifferentiated) and in MDA-MB-468 breast cancer cells' as 'Embargoed at the time of the June 2026 release'. known_limitations compounds the contradiction by describing 'Embargoed Perturb-seq data for KOLF2.1J iPSCs' as not yet available, while cm4ai_perturb-seq_KOLF2_cell_atlas.zip and cm4ai_perturb-seq_KOLF2_raw_sra.zip are listed as published 2026-06-17. A reader cannot determine which Perturb-seq data the release actually contains.
issues_detected.recommendation: Reconcile the three statements: restrict the description's Perturb-seq claim to the KOLF2.1J cell atlas and raw SRA archives that are actually distributed, and narrow the embargo notes in external_resources and known_limitations to the MDA-MB-468 Perturb-seq data alone.

issues_detected.description: No software is named for producing or transforming any file actually distributed in this release. The processed_data collections (cm4ai_mass-spec_KOLF2.zip, cm4ai_mass-spec_MDA-MB-468.zip, cm4ai_perturb-seq_KOLF2_cell_atlas.zip) must have passed through mass-spectrometry search/quantification and single-cell alignment/counting software, none of which is stated. The tooling that is documented occupies excluded roles: node2vec, DenseNet-121, HiDeF, GPT-4/GSAI and the Cell Mapping Toolkit constitute the MuSIC cell-map pipeline, whose outputs the record itself states are absent ('It does not contain predicted cell maps'; 'computed cell maps are not included'); FAIRSCAPE packages the release and generates its provenance metadata without transforming the data inside it; the 10x Genomics 3'HT kit and the pipetting robot are capture instrumentation.
issues_detected.recommendation: Name, with versions, the software that produced the distributed processed data (for example the MS search/quantification engine behind the SEC-MS and AP-MS archives and the single-cell pipeline behind the CRISPRi Perturbation Cell Atlas), attaching it via used_software on the relevant preprocessing_strategies or cleaning_strategies entries.

issues_detected.description: No variable-level metadata is provided anywhere in the record. The variables slot is absent, and no data dictionary, column description or field-level identifier is given for the SEC-MS elution profiles, AP-MS interaction records or the CRISPRi transcriptional/fitness phenotype matrices, so a reuser cannot know the internal structure of any distributed archive before downloading it.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add variables entries with identifiers, descriptions and units for the tabular contents of each processed_data archive, at minimum for the Perturbation Cell Atlas and the SEC-MS elution profile tables.

issues_detected.description: Distribution format information stops at the container. distribution_formats declares only 'ZIP Archive' (application/zip) and 'RO-Crate'; the formats of the files inside the archives are unstated (image format of the confocal images, mass-spectrometry format, sequence format), and no character encoding is given for any text or tabular payload. raw_data_sources supplies only the informal 'Confocal microscopy image with four color channels'.
issues_detected.recommendation: State the payload formats and media types per file collection (for example OME-TIFF or PNG for imaging, mzML for mass spectrometry, FASTQ for sequence, MTX/H5AD for the cell atlas) and the character encoding of any tabular or text components.

issues_detected.description: Neither anomalies nor missing_data_documentation is populated. The record documents sampling design and scope limitations thoroughly, but no data-quality anomalies, outliers, failed runs, low-quality antibody stainings or missing-value patterns are reported, despite cleaning_strategies stating that single-cell CRISPR screen data were 'undergoing quality control'.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add anomalies entries recording known quality issues (for example antibody stainings failing the Human Protein Atlas score, low-coverage SEC-MS fractions, filtered cells or guides) and document missing-value patterns for the Perturbation Cell Atlas.

issues_detected.description: The deidentification statement asserts a conclusion without naming a method or an assessing authority: 'CM4AI data are non-clinical (from tissue cultures) and are considered to be de-identified as they cannot be matched, with current knowledge, to a human subject.' The release nonetheless distributes genome-scale single-cell transcriptomic and raw sequence data from a named, traceable donor-derived line (KOLF2.1J, RRID:CVCL_B5P3, a HipSci line from a healthy male Northern European donor), which carries donor genotype information; the blanket non-matchability claim is not supported by any stated risk assessment.
issues_detected.recommendation: State the basis of the deidentification determination (upstream sourcing from de-identified commercial and consortium lines under MTA, with no further procedure applied) and add an explicit re-identification risk assessment addressing donor genotype recoverable from the Perturb-seq and raw SRA data.

issues_detected.description: No change descriptions or errata are provided for this release. errata is absent, and updates.update_details describes only the forward-looking quarterly cadence; nothing states what changed between the October 2025 release (doi:10.18130/V3/K7TGEM) and this one, even though four prior releases are enumerated in version_access and related_datasets.

issues_detected.description: Version numbering across the release series is non-monotonic: this June 2026 release is version 2.0, while version_access records the earlier June 2025 and October 2025 releases at version 2.1 and the March 2025 release at 1.4. This is explicable because each release carries its own DOI and therefore its own independent Dataverse version counter, but the record does not say so, and a reader comparing the enumerated versions may infer a regression.
issues_detected.recommendation: Note in version_access that version numbers are per-DOI Dataverse revision counters and are not comparable across releases.

semantic_insights: The DOI prefix 10.18130 is a Dataverse prefix and resolves consistently with publisher ROR:0153tk833 (University of Virginia), the citation string naming 'University of Virginia Dataverse', and the access URL domain dataverse.lib.virginia.edu - a three-way identifier agreement.

Both NIH award numbers are well formed and institute-consistent: 1OT2OD032742-01 (OT2 other-transaction mechanism, OD Office of the Director, matching the Bridge2AI program) and 5U54HG012513-02 (U54 center, HG NHGRI, matching the Bridge2AI Bridge Center). The funders note further supplies the RePORTER core project number, application ID, PI, organization and project period.

Cell line RRIDs are correctly namespaced Cellosaurus identifiers (RRID:CVCL_0419 for MDA-MB-468, RRID:CVCL_B5P3 for KOLF2.1J) and are tied to their sources (ATCC and the HipSci resource), which substantiates the ethical-sourcing claim rather than merely asserting it.

The human-subjects determination is coherent across four independent fields: human_subject_research.involves_human_subjects is false, direct_collection.is_direct is false with the explanation that all data were generated in vitro, confidential_elements_present is false, and sensitive_elements_present is false, each with a matching rationale rather than a bare flag.

Licensing is consistent in three places that often disagree: license_and_use_terms states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 with data_use_permission no_commercial_use, prohibited_uses independently prohibits commercial use, and ip_restrictions identifies the specific copyright holders (Regents of the University of California; Board of Trustees of Leland Stanford Junior University for the raw imaging) and the negotiation path.

The bias declaration is substantiated rather than asserted: known_biases records representation_bias with affected_subsets, and sampling_strategies independently sets is_representative false with a matching why_not_representative statement and donor-level source_data for both cell lines.

The scope limitation is stated consistently in three registers - known_limitations ('does not contain predicted cell maps'), intended_uses ('computed cell maps are not included'), and discouraged_uses ('Use as a complete cell-map resource is discouraged at this stage') - which is an unusually disciplined treatment of an interim release.

source_caveats disclose and adjudicate genuine source conflicts rather than silently picking a value: the 464-versus-563 protein count across release pages, the Andrej Sali affiliation discrepancy between the release metadata and the preprint, the project-level aggregate counts deliberately not attributed to this release, and the U2OS cell map from the same groups explicitly excluded as a distinct dataset.
total_file_count (10) matches the ten file_collections entries exactly, and all ten MD5 checksums are well-formed 32-character hexadecimal digests paired with sizes and publication dates.

Ontology-grounded terms are used where free text would have sufficed: data_substrate and data_topic carry B2AI codes, creators carry ORCIDs, affiliations and publisher carry RORs, and conforms_to_standard uses the RO_CRATE enum alongside the prose conforms_to.

Governance is operational rather than nominal: a named Data Access Committee with an access_review_process covering distribution and potential dual licensing, a committee contact, two named ethics contacts with ORCIDs and institutional emails, and three maintainers with distinct roles and addresses.

The ORCIDs cited in ethical_reviews match those in creators exactly.

It does not contain predicted cell maps, which will be added in future releases', with scope_impact 'most suitable for bioinformatics analysis of the individual datasets rather than for analysis of integrated cell maps'; coverage_limitation - 'SEC-MS, IF imaging, and CRISPRi Perturb-seq data interrogate sets of proteins which incompletely overlap'; integration_limitation - 'Some datasets are under temporary pre-publication embargo', with recommended_mitigation; methodological_limitation - 'Requires domain expertise for meaningful analysis'
sub_elements.quality_note: Each limitation is categorised, explained and, where possible, accompanied by its practical impact or a mitigation - and the incomplete-overlap limitation is a genuinely useful disclosure that a less candid datasheet would omit, since it directly constrains multimodal integration.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: All four limitations are corroborated elsewhere: the scope limitation matches intended_uses and discouraged_uses; the embargo matches external_resources restrictions; the domain-expertise caution matches discouraged_uses. The embargo entry is also the locus of the high-severity contradiction with the description and file_collections over the KOLF2 Perturb-seq data.

sub_elements.name: Biases Categorized Using Standard Taxonomy (RAI-aligned)
sub_elements.evidence: known_biases: bias_type 'representation_bias' with bias_description 'Data in this release was derived from commercially available de-identified human cell lines and does not represent all biological variants which may be seen in the population at large' and affected_subsets 'All data in the release, spanning MDA-MB-468 breast cancer cells and KOLF2.1J iPSCs and their derivatives'. future_use_impacts (two entries) covering anticipated applications, governance integration and the ELSI toolkit
sub_elements.quality_note: The bias is typed against a recognisable taxonomy term rather than described in free prose, and its scope is stated explicitly as covering the whole release rather than left vague.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: representation_bias is the semantically correct category for a two-cell-line dataset, and the claim is independently corroborated by sampling_strategies.is_representative: false with a matching why_not_representative - a cross-field agreement that is frequently absent. Only one bias type is recorded; ancestry-specific limitations implied by the donor characteristics in sampling_strategies.source_data (one Black female donor, one Northern European male donor) are not separately categorised, which is a warning rather than a failure.

sub_elements.name: Data Anomalies and Quality Issues Noted
sub_elements.evidence: The anomalies slot is absent from the record. The closest content is cleaning_strategies, which states only that 'Single-cell CRISPR screen data from MDA-MB-468 cells and undifferentiated KOLF2.1J iPSCs were reported as undergoing quality control at the time of the CM4AI preprint', and acquisition_methods, which notes that antibody quality was scored under a Human Protein Atlas protocol without reporting any outcome of that scoring.
sub_elements.quality_note: Scored 0. No anomaly, outlier, batch effect, failed acquisition or excluded sample is reported anywhere, despite the record itself signalling that quality control was in progress and that antibodies were scored - both of which imply findings that are not disclosed. missing_data_documentation is likewise absent.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: The gap is conspicuous rather than neutral: a multimodal release combining antibody-based imaging, mass spectrometry and pooled CRISPR screening would ordinarily have modality-specific quality caveats, and the datasheet's candour elsewhere makes the silence here stand out. Distinct from the scope and coverage issues captured under known_limitations, which concern what the release contains rather than the quality of what it contains.

sub_elements.name: Sensitive Content and Warnings Provided
sub_elements.evidence: sensitive_elements: sensitive_elements_present: false with sensitivity_details 'CM4AI data are non-clinical, derived from tissue cultures, and are considered to be de-identified as they cannot be matched, with current knowledge, to a human subject'. content_warnings: content_warnings_present: false. confidential_elements: confidential_elements_present: false with details 'The release records Human Subjects: No; De-identified Samples: Yes; FDA Regulated: No'
sub_elements.quality_note: The negative determinations are reasoned rather than blank: each flag carries the basis on which it was reached, which is meaningful documentation and lets a reader judge the determination rather than merely accept it.
sub_elements.semantic_validation: All three flags agree with each other and with human_subject_research.involves_human_subjects: false, is_deidentified.identifiable_elements_present: false and regulatory_restrictions - a five-way consistency that holds. The same 'cannot be matched, with current knowledge' formulation carries the caveat noted under Element 4 sub-element 2 regarding donor genotype in the released sequence data.

sub_elements.name: Ethical Review and Social Impact Analysis
sub_elements.evidence: ethical_reviews: two entries describing the Ethics Module's remit - 'a plan for ethical preparation, licensing, dissemination, and Data Access supervision of CM4AI datasets, balancing openness of the data produced with protection of intellectual property and supervision and monitoring of potential efforts at commercialization' - with two named contacts and institutional emails. future_use_impacts: 'Anticipating potential applications of the data and derived AI/ML systems, integrating them into data governance frameworks to optimize benefits and mitigate potential risks, and promoting their use for the collective good, is a stated ethical requirement of the project'; 'The Ethics team is developing a suite of tools aimed at enhancing awareness and comprehension of the ethical, legal, and social ramifications associated with CM4AI data and the consequent AI systems'

strengths: Exceptional cross-field identifier discipline: the DOI prefix, publisher ROR, citation text and access URL all resolve to the University of Virginia Dataverse, contributor ORCIDs cited in ethical_reviews and data_governance match those in creators exactly, cell lines carry Cellosaurus RRIDs tied to named suppliers, and all ten MD5 digests are well formed with total_file_count matching the inventory.

The human-subjects determination is coherent across five independent fields rather than asserted once, and the negative flags (sensitive_elements, content_warnings, confidential_elements) each carry the reasoning behind the determination, which makes them documentation rather than blanks.

Bias and sampling disclosure is mutually corroborating and unusually candid: known_biases records a typed representation_bias whose claim is independently supported by sampling_strategies setting is_representative false with a matching explanation and donor-level source_data for both parent lines.

source_caveats adjudicates genuine source conflicts in the open - the 464-versus-563 protein count across release pages, the Sali affiliation discrepancy, project-level aggregates deliberately not attributed to this release, and a same-group U2OS cell map explicitly excluded as a distinct dataset - which is the transparency an evaluator can least easily verify and most values.

Funding transparency extends beyond naming an agency: both NIH award numbers validate against activity-code and institute conventions, and the RePORTER core project number, application ID, supplement number, PI, organisation, project period and award amount make the funding independently checkable.

The interim character of the release is stated consistently in four registers - known_limitations, intended_uses, discouraged_uses and the description - so a user cannot mistake a component-data release for the cell-map resource the programme is ultimately building.
weaknesses: No software is named for producing or transforming any distributed file. The three processed_data archives passed through mass-spectrometry search and single-cell counting software that is nowhere identified, while the richly documented tooling (node2vec, DenseNet-121, HiDeF, GPT-4/GSAI, the Cell Mapping Toolkit) belongs to the cell-map pipeline whose outputs the record states are absent, and FAIRSCAPE only packages the release.

The description's claim that the release includes MDA-MB-468 Perturb-seq data is contradicted by the file inventory and by the embargo recorded in external_resources, while known_limitations simultaneously describes the KOLF2.1J Perturb-seq data as embargoed even though two KOLF2 Perturb-seq archives are listed as published - a reader cannot determine what the release actually contains.

Variable-level metadata is entirely absent, and unlike the record's other omissions this one is not acknowledged in source_caveats; no data dictionary exists for the CRISPRi Perturbation Cell Atlas or the SEC-MS tables, so integration requires reverse-engineering the payloads.

Format specification stops at the container: 'ZIP Archive' and RO-Crate are declared, but the image, mass-spectrometry and sequence formats inside the archives, and character encoding for any tabular component, are unstated.

Neither anomalies nor missing_data_documentation is populated, despite the record itself noting that CRISPR screen quality control was in progress and that antibodies were scored under a Human Protein Atlas protocol - both imply findings that go unreported.

No change documentation exists for the fifth release in a quarterly series: errata is absent and updates.update_details is purely prospective, so a user holding the October 2025 release cannot tell what changed.
recommendations: Attach used_software, with versions, to the preprocessing_strategies and cleaning_strategies entries that correspond to the distributed processed_data archives - the MS search and quantification engine behind the SEC-MS and AP-MS files and the single-cell alignment and counting pipeline behind the Perturbation Cell Atlas - and distinguish these in the record from the MuSIC cell-map tooling whose outputs are not released.

Reconcile the Perturb-seq statements: restrict the description to the KOLF2.1J cell atlas and raw SRA archives actually distributed, and narrow the embargo notes in external_resources and known_limitations to the MDA-MB-468 Perturb-seq data alone.

Add variables entries with identifiers, descriptions and units for the tabular contents of each processed_data archive, and state the payload formats and media types per file collection (for example OME-TIFF, mzML, FASTQ, MTX/H5AD) together with character encoding for text components.

Populate anomalies with the quality findings the record already implies - antibody stainings failing the HPA score, low-coverage SEC-MS fractions, filtered cells or guides - and add missing_data_documentation for the Perturbation Cell Atlas.

Add release notes in updates.update_details or errata entries enumerating what was added, corrected or withdrawn relative to doi:10.18130/V3/K7TGEM, and note that Dataverse version numbers are per-DOI counters that are not comparable across releases.

Strengthen the deidentification record by stating its basis (upstream sourcing from de-identified ATCC and HipSci lines under MTA, with no further procedure applied) and adding an explicit re-identification risk assessment addressing donor genotype recoverable from the released Perturb-seq and raw SRA data.

Fill the remaining machine-readable governance slots: set regulatory_restrictions.confidentiality_level, populate download_url with the Dataverse access URL, add a conflict-of-interest declaration to ethical_reviews, and either record a data protection impact assessment or state why none was required.
